claim: Islands open ~March-October; ~95% of resorts close Nov-Mar for the NE monsoon; best weather May-Sep.
quote: November to March is the monsoon season... most of the services are closed. Around 95% of resorts close for seasonal maintenance.

claim: No ATMs on the islands; cash only; costs in RM; nightly fire party at Bubu; turtle watching on Turtle Beach Jun-Sep.
quote: There are no ATMs on the islands, and would-be thieves know that everyone has lots of cash on them.

claim: Perhentian glow plankton best viewed near Long Beach, dry season Apr-Sep, new-moon nights ~8pm-midnight; night-snorkel tours available.
quote: Pulau Perhentian is a popular spot for viewing glow-in-the-dark plankton, with the best viewing near Long Beach.

claim: Sugar Wreck is a ~90 m sugar hauler sunk in 2000, resting ~18 m down west of Kecil, ~20 min by boat; advanced dive, best Mar-Apr.
quote: a 90 m long sugar hauler sunk in 2000 during a monsoon

claim: Romantic Beach and secluded Adam & Eve beach; mosque interior tour free; ferry MYR35 each way; boat to Adam & Eve ~30 MYR.
quote: the most fish at Romantic Beach, and the corals were also the most colourful

claim: Volunteers do kayak photo-ID surveys and red-light night nesting patrols; in 2019 protected 28,801 eggs across 316 nests.
quote: Protected 28,801 turtle eggs from 316 nests

claim: Bidong was a Vietnamese refugee camp 1978-1991, peak ~40,000, ~250,000 total; reopened to tourism 1999; now a UMT marine research station.
quote: By June 1979 it was said to be the most densely populated place on earth with about 40,000 refugees.

claim: Teluk Dalam is Besar's largest, quietest big beach; D'Lagoon reported derelict and full of trash in 2026.
quote: in 2026, D'lagoon is completely derelict and full of trash

claim: Draw cash at Kota Bharu airport or Jerteh (~20 min from Kuala Besut jetty) before going to the islands.
quote: obtain sufficient cash from the ATM machines at Kota Bharu Airport or at Jerteh which is 20 minutes away.

claim: Cash advances at Bubu/Senja with 10% fee; afternoon blackouts on Besar; water refills ~RM1.50; monitor lizards; sea lice; alcohol limits; blacktips.
quote: Cash advances can be had on Kecil at Bubu Long Beach Resort and Senja Bay Resort... Both charge a hefty 10% fee.

claim: Operators rely on diesel generators daily; diesel ~RM5.12/litre in 2026; running costs up 50-70%.
quote: rely on generators daily to keep basic operations running... operating costs on the island have risen 50% to 70%.

claim: Budget-place electricity roughly 7pm-8am; afternoon blackouts; waste/trash and forest-burning problems; fierce mosquitoes.
quote: electricity only 7 p.m.–8 a.m.

claim: A solar/wind mini-grid was installed to supplement generator power on Perhentian.
quote: Perhentian Minigrid

claim: In June 2026 ~1 MYR ≈ 0.21 EUR, i.e. €1 ≈ RM4.7.
quote: As of June 09, 2026, 1.00 MYR equals 0.212886 EUR.

claim: Kayaks rent ~RM25/hr (€5.50) or RM60/day (€13) from Long Beach or Coral Bay to reach hidden coves.
quote: Kayaks can be rented by the hour (25RM, €5.50) or the day (60RM, €13) from either Long Beach or Coral Bay.

claim: Bungalow break-ins reported with no real police presence; everything costs more than the mainland; WiFi patchy; trash issues.
quote: There have been several reports of bungalows being broken into.

claim: The glow is dinoflagellates (e.g. Noctiluca scintillans) flashing light when agitated; harmless to swim through.
quote: Sea sparkle dinoflagellates like Noctiluca scintillans are responsible for the dramatic blue shorelines.

claim: Malaysia has several 'blue tears' bioluminescence spots; avoid harmful chemicals and don't disturb the plankton.
quote: 7 Dreamy Locations To Catch Sight Of Blue Tears In Malaysia

claim: The Sugar Wreck was MV Union Star, ran aground near Pantai Sri Tujuh Nov 2000 (all 17 crew rescued), and finally sank ~22 Dec 2000.
quote: The Sugar Wreck (MV Union Star 17) ran aground on a sand bank near Pantai Sri Tujuh in November 2000.

claim: Sugar Wreck is a recognised PADI dive site in the Perhentian Islands, Malaysia.
quote: SUGAR WRECK dive site

claim: Sugar Wreck hosts bamboo sharks, giant pufferfish, squid, scorpionfish, cuttlefish; Tokong Laut and T3 are the other top dives.
quote: A sunken freighter from 2000 housing bamboo sharks, giant pufferfish, squid, scorpionfish and cuttlefish encounters.

claim: Northern beaches Adam & Eve, Turtle Beach, D'Lagoon and Romantic require rocky-trail hiking or boat access; kayak rentals reach remote beaches.
quote: Lesser-known northern beaches—Adam and Eve, Turtle Beach, D'Lagoon, and Romantic Beach—require rocky trail hiking or boat access.

claim: A foot path from quiet Coral Bay passes 3-4 secluded beaches en route to the fishing village; Long Beach is one long row of development.
quote: a little path that leads for after an hour or so to a fishing village. Along this route, you'll find three or four really secluded beautiful beaches.

claim: D'Lagoon (NW Kecil) has a reef just metres from shore plus small unnamed private beaches; off-grid and quiet.
quote: D'Lagoon has a beautiful reef full of life just a few meters from the shore... a couple of small and private, unnamed beaches next to D'Lagoon.

claim: From Tuna Bay (Besar) a stone walkway south reaches quiet Teluk KK; a steep 15-min jungle trek north reaches Turtle Beach.
quote: you can either walk south along the beach and stone walkways to the beautiful, quiet Teluk KK beach.

claim: Kayaking is a popular way to explore Perhentian Kecil's remote beaches and hidden coves.
quote: Paddle in Paradise: Kayak the Crystal Waters of Pulau Perhentian

claim: 10-15 min jungle trail links Long Beach and Coral Bay (trailheads by Mummy Burger / Ombak Resort); unlit at night so carry a torch; monitor lizards up to 2 m.
quote: it is not lit at night. If you are crossing back to your resort after dinner or a fire show, you must carry a flashlight (torch).

claim: Windmill Hill offers a crowd-free sunrise and 360 views; Coral Bay (Kecil) and Teluk Keke (Besar) are the best sunset spots.
quote: Windmill Hill offers a peaceful, crowd-free experience with light across the sea that is simply breathtaking for catching the sunrise.

claim: Hike from end of Long Beach ~45 min to the windmill viewpoint for views over both islands.
quote: From Long Beach, you can walk to the Windmill (45 minutes).

claim: Six-foot monitor lizards forage under the bungalows; snorkelling shows juvenile blacktip sharks.
quote: foraging six-foot monitor lizards who hung out under our bungalows.

claim: Territorial triggerfish can attack swimmers.
quote: triggerfish which can be territorial and attack swimmers.

claim: Kampung Pasir Hantu is the islands' only local settlement, with a school, mosque and police station.
quote: the only local settlement in the islands with facilities like a school, mosque, and police station.

claim: Kampung Pasir Hantu (Fisherman Village) is on Kecil's southeast corner, the only settlement with school/mosque/police.
quote: the only local settlement in the islands with facilities like a school, mosque, and police station.

claim: Fishing village offers a new perspective on island life (kids cycling sandy paths) and lower prices, but 'not a great deal to see or do.'
quote: children ride their bikes along sandy paths... not a great deal to see or do here.

claim: Perhentian Turtle Project is based in Kampung Pasir Hantu with night patrols on Tiga Ruang/Turtle Beach; green and hawksbill turtles.
quote: Based in Kampung Pasir Hantu (Fishermen Village)... Pantai Tiga Ruang (Turtle Beach) is where nightly patrols occur.

claim: Night patrols on Tiga Ruang run hourly (e.g. 21:00-02:00); project operates Apr-Sep, peak Jul-Sep; volunteers must be 18+ confident swimmers.
quote: patrolling the beach every hour to monitor for any turtle activity between 21:00 - 02:00 or 02:00 - 07:00.

claim: Bubbles resort sits on a turtle nesting beach and runs a turtle conservation / hatchery program with guest viewings.
quote: Experience/Volunteer | Bubbles Turtle Conservation

claim: Perhentian turtle volunteering is offered as an island holiday with conservation work.
quote: Perhentian Turtle Volunteering island holiday adventure

claim: Refugees built multi-storey huts from wrecked-boat timber; water rationed to one gallon/day; ~40,000 at peak.
quote: Water was rationed at one gallon per day per person.

claim: Pulau Bidong once housed more than 40,000 Vietnamese refugees at one time.
quote: This island in Terengganu once housed more than 40,000 refugees at one time.

claim: Primary heritage record of the Pulau Bidong refugee camp's history and conditions.
quote: Pulau Bidong - Vietnamese Heritage Museum

claim: Freedive Perhentian teaches the worldwide-recognised Apnea Total freediving system from beginner to advanced, based on Long Beach.
quote: Freedive Perhentian follows the Apnea Total Freediving Education System which provides certifications that are recognized worldwide.

claim: Perhentian Freediving / Andrasa Studio offers beginner-to-advanced freediving courses and leisure dives based on Pulau Perhentian.
quote: Perhentian Freediving | Certifications and Leisure

claim: D'Lagoon offers off-grid, hammock-by-the-beach lodging on a quiet bay.
quote: lying in a hammock by the beach, the gentle sway lulls you into a state of relaxa...

claim: Beach Bar on Long Beach is famed for nightly fire shows starting ~10pm.
quote: Beach Bar on Long Beach is famed for cocktails and nightly fire shows starting at 10 pm.

claim: Long Beach nightlife is loud party EDM with fire shows and parties until ~2am.
quote: The music is largely party EDM music.
